as_told.title: Karl Nell on a secret decades-long arms race

plain: The United States is said to be in a secret race with Russia and China to take apart and copy captured UFOs, a process called reverse engineering. The claim comes from Karl Nell, who helped found Army Futures Command, the US Army's modernisation headquarters, in remarks published by The Debrief, an online news site. Michels repeats it several times, calling Nell his friend and saying that if Nell is right, the race is going on right now. In one telling Michels calls it a sub rosa, or hidden, conflict that has been going on for decades, and he mentions it alongside David Grusch, a former intelligence officer who has said the government holds such craft. An online researcher who goes by the name UAPGerb also cites Nell, though without the race. In his version Nell says the US actively has craft and is working out how to run their systems. All tellers are passing on what Nell said, not anything they saw. If true, it would mean these craft are real and that rival nations are fighting quietly to master them.
